metrics.name: blended_mer
metrics.plain: Total new-customer revenue for every dollar of ad spend, across all channels
metrics.formula: total new customer revenue / total spend (Meta + TikTok + Google)
metrics.source: brand brain revenue ledger + ad platform spend
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a new order pull
metrics.unavailable_when: brand brain revenue ledger not connected
metrics.benchmark: brand's own target, set from contribution margin (source: MEDIA-C08)

metrics.name: meta_platform_roas
metrics.plain: What Meta itself says it returned
metrics.formula: purchase value / spend, period totals only
metrics.unavailable_when: no reported purchase value in range

metrics.name: tiktok_platform_roas
metrics.plain: What TikTok itself says it returned
metrics.formula: attributed revenue / spend, period totals only
metrics.unavailable_when: TikTok account not connected or no spend in range

metrics.name: new_customer_cac
metrics.plain: What it costs to win one new customer
metrics.formula: total spend / new customers acquired
metrics.unavailable_when: new-vs-existing customer flag missing on orders
metrics.benchmark: gross profit on first order (GP-to-CAC target from MEDIA-C08)

metrics.name: frequency_by_segment_30d
metrics.plain: How many times the same person saw an ad in 30 days, by audience, not blended
metrics.formula: impressions / reach per audience segment, 30-day window
metrics.benchmark: rising frequency with flat cold reach flags fatigue

metrics.name: spend_pace_vs_budget
metrics.plain: Are we on track to land on this month's budget
metrics.formula: (spend to date / days elapsed) x days in month, vs planned monthly budget
metrics.source: ad platform daily spend + brand's stated monthly budget
metrics.unavailable_when: monthly budget not set by founder

metrics.name: month_end_mer_forecast
metrics.plain: Where blended MER is heading if nothing changes
metrics.formula: trailing 7-day MER projected across remaining days, weighted by trailing pace
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 7 days of MER history

metrics.name: adset_verdict
metrics.plain: Keep, watch or kill, read at the ad set level
metrics.formula: ROAS vs target read at 3x to 5x target CPA spent (rule set in MEDIA-C17)
metrics.source: ad platform ad set metrics + brand's target CPA
metrics.unavailable_when: ad set has spent under 1x target CPA (not enough data)
metrics.benchmark: n/a, this is the rule itself

metrics.name: creative_volume_ratio
metrics.plain: New ads launched against the $1,000-of-spend benchmark
metrics.formula: new ads launched in period / (monthly spend / 1000)
metrics.benchmark: about 1 new ad per $1,000 monthly spend (MEDIA-C16)

metrics.name: concept_count_vs_band
metrics.plain: Number of live concepts against the band for this spend tier
metrics.formula: count of distinct SKU + pain-point + offer concepts currently live
metrics.unavailable_when: naming convention not followed (cannot parse concepts)

metrics.name: existing_customer_spend_share
metrics.plain: Share of spend protecting existing customers vs winning new ones
metrics.formula: spend in the dedicated existing-customer campaign / total spend
metrics.source: campaign-level spend, tagged by campaign purpose
metrics.benchmark: cold spend share should be growing period over period

metrics.name: dpa_7day_click_roas
metrics.plain: Dynamic product ad return, read the way it should be read
metrics.formula: attributed value on 7-day click window / DPA ad set spend
metrics.source: Meta ad account, DPA ad sets only
metrics.benchmark: never compared to blended platform ROAS

metrics.name: pixel_capi_match_quality
metrics.plain: How well orders and their value are passing through to Meta
metrics.formula: event match quality score + share of purchase events with value populated
metrics.benchmark: above 6.0 match quality, 100% of purchases carry value

metrics.name: suggestion_log_status
metrics.plain: How many platform suggestions were applied without a logged test
metrics.formula: count of applied Advantage+/automated suggestions with no before/after entry
metrics.source: suggestion log (brand record) + platform change history

metrics.name: tiktok_spark_authorization_days_left
metrics.plain: Days left on a creator's Spark authorization
metrics.formula: 365 - days since authorization code granted, per active Sparked post
metrics.unavailable_when: no Spark authorization on file for an active post

metrics.name: account_quality_flags
metrics.plain: Open policy rejections or account-quality warnings across Meta and TikTok
metrics.formula: count of open disapprovals / quality flags
metrics.source: Meta and TikTok account activity logs

metrics.name: message_match_lag_days
metrics.plain: Days since the best-performing ad's headline last matched the landing page
metrics.formula: days since landing page headline was updated to mirror the current top ad's headline
metrics.source: ad creative text + landing page snapshot
metrics.unavailable_when: landing page not connected for snapshotting

metrics.name: stock_pace_risk
metrics.plain: Whether a scaling ad set is about to sell out its product
metrics.formula: days of stock left at current sales pace, for products in ad sets tagged Scale
metrics.source: brand's stock feed + ad set product tags
metrics.benchmark: flag under 14 days of stock left

metrics.name: competitor_discount_overlap
metrics.plain: Shared products a competitor is discounting 20% or more
metrics.formula: count of the brand's ad-featured products also seen discounted 20-30%+ in competitor ad library snapshot
metrics.source: competitor ad library data + brand product ad tags

metrics.name: marginal_roas_by_channel
metrics.plain: What the next dollar of spend would likely return, by channel
metrics.formula: change in value / change in spend over the last 2 comparable budget steps, per channel
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 budget steps to compare
metrics.benchmark: used only for founder-gate allocation calls (MEDIA-C58)

insights.name: MER disagrees with platform ROAS
insights.rule: blended MER is 20% or more below Meta or TikTok's own reported ROAS for the same period
insights.sentence: Meta says {platform_roas}x but the brand's own numbers say {blended_mer}x. Check attribution before scaling.

insights.name: kill/keep/scale table
insights.rule: at 3x to 5x target CPA spent with ROAS more than 30% below target and no purchases, mark Kill; within 30% of target, mark Watch; at or above target, mark Scale
insights.sentence: {n} ad sets are ready to kill, {n} to scale.

insights.name: frequency rising, reach flat
insights.rule: 30-day frequency for a segment up 20% or more while cold reach for that segment is flat or falling
insights.sentence: {segment} frequency hit {freq}x with reach flat. Creative is wearing out, not the audience.
insights.severity: medium, rises with spend at risk

insights.name: spend or ROAS anomaly
insights.rule: a day's spend or ROAS moved 50% or more against the trailing 14-day median
insights.sentence: {date} spend moved {pct}% against the last 14 days. {ad_names} caused most of it.
insights.severity: high on the day it happens

insights.name: anomaly root cause fan-out
insights.rule: when an anomaly fires, pull same-day site speed, stock level and competitor activity automatically
insights.sentence: The {date} drop lines up with {cause} on the same day.
insights.severity: attached to the anomaly it explains

insights.name: creative volume below benchmark
insights.rule: new ads launched in 30 days is under 70% of (monthly spend / 1000)
insights.sentence: Only {n} new ads launched this month against a benchmark of {target}.

insights.name: DPA in the wrong bucket
insights.rule: a dynamic product ad set is inside the main cold CBO instead of its own capped ad set
insights.sentence: DPA is sharing budget with cold prospecting. Give it its own capped ad set.

insights.name: naming or purpose gap
insights.rule: a live campaign has no one-line purpose on file or its ad sets do not follow the fixed naming pattern
insights.sentence: {n} campaigns have no purpose line on file.

insights.name: scaling into a stockout
insights.rule: an ad set marked Scale features a product with under 14 days of stock left
insights.sentence: {ad_set} is scaling {product}, which has {days} days of stock left.

insights.name: competitor discount on a shared product
insights.rule: a competitor is discounting a product the brand also runs ads for by 20% or more
insights.sentence: {competitor} cut {product} by {pct}%. Consider pulling or de-prioritising it.

insights.name: message mismatch
insights.rule: the current top ad's headline has not appeared on the landing page within 1 day of becoming the top ad
insights.sentence: The top ad says '{headline}' but the landing page still says something else, {days} days on.

insights.name: unlogged platform suggestion
insights.rule: a platform-applied Advantage+ or automated suggestion has no before/after entry in the suggestion log
insights.sentence: {n} suggestions were applied with no test on record.

insights.name: Spark authorization expiring
insights.rule: an active Sparked post's creator authorization has 30 days or fewer left
insights.sentence: {creator}'s Spark authorization expires in {days} days.
insights.severity: high, ad stops delivering if it lapses

insights.name: policy rejection pattern
insights.rule: 2 or more rejections in 30 days cite the same policy clause
insights.sentence: {n} ads were rejected for {clause} this month. Fix the pattern, not just the ad.

insights.name: founder-gate queue non-empty
insights.rule: any decision the idea bank or catalogue marks founder_gate is open and unresolved
insights.sentence: {n} decisions are waiting on you: {labels}.

visuals.name: pacing gauge
visuals.shows: month-to-date spend vs planned budget, with a projected end-of-month line
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees in one glance if the month is on track

visuals.name: kill/keep/scale table
visuals.shows: every live ad set, its ROAS, spend and verdict, ranked by spend at risk
visuals.why_this_chart: matches the existing ads gallery verdict pattern (insights.js verdictChip), extended to ad-set level

visuals.name: frequency by segment small multiples
visuals.type: small line charts, one per audience segment
visuals.shows: 30-day frequency trend per segment against cold reach
visuals.why_this_chart: a blended frequency number hides which segment is actually fatigued

visuals.name: anomaly strip
visuals.shows: every day in the range shaded by how far spend or ROAS moved from the 14-day median
visuals.why_this_chart: founder spots the bad day without reading a table

visuals.name: MER bridge
visuals.shows: Meta ROAS, TikTok ROAS and blended MER side by side with the gap labelled
visuals.why_this_chart: makes the attribution gap visible instead of buried in two separate numbers

visuals.name: change log timeline
visuals.shows: every structure, bid or targeting change with who made it and the before/after read
visuals.why_this_chart: founder can see what changed and whether it worked, not just that it changed

visuals.name: TikTok organic-to-Spark timeline
visuals.shows: post date, 5 to 7 day organic read, Spark date, authorization expiry
visuals.why_this_chart: the loop only works if the timing is followed; visualising it catches a skipped step

visuals.name: marginal ROAS bars
visuals.shows: the next-dollar return estimate per channel, side by side
visuals.why_this_chart: founder allocates the next dollar by comparing bars, not spreadsheets

not_elsewhere.claim: puts ad-set kill/keep/scale verdicts next to same-day stock level and competitor discount data, not performance numbers alone
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and rule tools like Revealbot judge only spend, ROAS and frequency inside the ad account; they do not see stock or competitor moves

not_elsewhere.claim: computes blended MER from the brand's own contribution margin and reconciles it against Meta's and TikTok's own reported ROAS every time before a scale call
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager report only their own platform ROAS; also in Triple Whale for a blended revenue number, but Triple Whale's number is not tied back to the brand's own margin ledger

not_elsewhere.claim: logs every Advantage+ or automated suggestion applied, with a persisted before/after read attached to it
not_elsewhere.vs: Ads Manager shows a suggestion feed but keeps no lasting before/after test log once a suggestion is applied

not_elsewhere.claim: fans one spend or ROAS anomaly out to the brand's own site speed, stock level and competitor snapshot from the same day, automatically
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager flag the anomaly inside the ad account but never look outside it for the cause

not_elsewhere.claim: tracks each TikTok Spark creator's 365-day authorization next to the organic post that earned it, with the expiry clock visible
not_elsewhere.vs: TikTok Ads Manager shows Spark ads live but not the organic-to-paid loop timing or authorization expiry in one place

not_elsewhere.claim: routes every founder-gate call (scale ceiling, order-confirmation-flow rollout, new-surface pilot, agentic-bidding guardrail) into one queue instead of leaving it split across ad account settings
not_elsewhere.vs: no platform separates its own automation's suggestions from the calls only the founder should make

founder_view_note: Before any connector is live, the room shows Meta-only numbers (already flowing through the existing gallery) and marks blended MER, TikTok ROAS, stock risk and competitor overlap as unavailable with a one-line reason each. The first thing that lands once the brand brain and stock feed connect is the MER bridge and the stock-pace risk flag, since those two catch the costliest mistakes (scaling on a wrong number, scaling into a stockout).

metrics.name: conversion_tracking_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of purchases where Google gets the real order value
metrics.formula: purchases with enhanced conversion value populated / total tracked purchases
metrics.unavailable_when: Google Ads read access not connected

metrics.name: merchant_center_health
metrics.plain: Whether Merchant Center is approved and add-ons are on
metrics.formula: count of open disapprovals + count of the 4 add-ons not enrolled

metrics.name: feed_title_quality
metrics.plain: Share of titles that lead with the actual converting search term
metrics.formula: titles starting with a top-20 converting search term / total live titles
metrics.unavailable_when: search terms report has under 20 terms with conversions

metrics.name: brand_nonbrand_split
metrics.plain: Spend and ROAS split between brand and non-brand
metrics.formula: spend and value summed separately for campaigns tagged brand vs non-brand
metrics.benchmark: brand excluded from every cold campaign by negative list and exclusion

metrics.name: nonbrand_cpa_vs_breakeven
metrics.plain: Is non-brand Search costing more than it can afford to
metrics.formula: non-brand CPA / break-even CPA (from margin)
metrics.source: Google Ads metrics + brand margin data

metrics.name: pmax_control_flags
metrics.plain: How many control-hiding defaults are still switched on in PMax
metrics.formula: count of: URL expansion on, auto assets on, final URL expansion on, across active PMax campaigns

metrics.name: pmax_search_terms_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of PMax spend with a visible search term behind it
metrics.formula: spend on search terms shown in the PMax insights report / total PMax search spend
metrics.unavailable_when: PMax insights report not available for the account
metrics.benchmark: as high as Google will show; flag when this falls, not a fixed target

metrics.name: search_term_waste
metrics.plain: Spend on search terms with no conversions over the waste threshold
metrics.formula: sum of spend on terms with 0 conversions and spend over 2x average CPA
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of search term data
metrics.benchmark: trending down after negatives are added

metrics.name: bid_strategy_stage
metrics.plain: Where the account sits on the bidding ladder
metrics.formula: current strategy (Maximize Conversion Value, or Target ROAS with X% of conversions from that strategy)
metrics.source: Google Ads bid strategy settings + conversion volume
metrics.benchmark: move to Target ROAS only once volume supports it (MEDIA-C39)

metrics.name: remarketing_list_size
metrics.plain: How big each remarketing list actually is
metrics.formula: member count per list
metrics.benchmark: above the platform's minimum size to serve

metrics.name: cart_abandoner_list_size
metrics.plain: Size of the add-to-cart-minus-purchase list
metrics.formula: add-to-cart audience minus purchaser audience, member count

metrics.name: budget_vs_sizing_formula
metrics.plain: Is today's budget in the recommended range for our stage
metrics.formula: daily budget / (3 to 4x AOV for Search and Shopping, or $50-100 and 3x non-brand CPA for PMax)
metrics.source: Google Ads budget settings + brand AOV

metrics.name: scaling_gates_passed
metrics.plain: How many of the 5 scaling gates the account currently passes
metrics.formula: count of gates passed out of 5 (fixed gate list from MEDIA-C41)
metrics.benchmark: 5 of 5 before adding budget or a new campaign type

metrics.name: youtube_demand_gen_readiness
metrics.plain: Whether Search and Shopping are dialled in enough to add video
metrics.formula: checklist score: Search/Shopping hitting target ROAS + proven Meta creative available + AOV fits video funnel
metrics.source: computed from campaign metrics + creative library
metrics.unavailable_when: Search/Shopping have not run 30 days at target

metrics.name: google_blended_mer_gap
metrics.plain: Gap between Google's own ROAS and the brand's blended MER
metrics.formula: Google-reported ROAS minus blended MER, as a percentage of Google's ROAS
metrics.source: Google Ads metrics + brand revenue ledger

metrics.name: disapproval_resolution_days
metrics.plain: How long a disapproved ad or product stays down
metrics.formula: days between disapproval flagged and resolved

metrics.name: spend_pace_vs_budget_google
metrics.plain: Month-to-date spend against plan, Google only
metrics.formula: (spend to date / days elapsed) x days in month vs planned monthly budget

metrics.name: new_customer_cac_google
metrics.plain: Cost to win one new customer through Google
metrics.formula: Google spend / new customers attributed to Google

metrics.name: addon_enrollment_status
metrics.plain: Which of the 4 Merchant Center add-ons are live
metrics.formula: count enrolled out of 4

metrics.name: campaign_purpose_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of live campaigns with a written one-line purpose
metrics.formula: campaigns with a purpose note on file / total live campaigns
metrics.source: brand record + Google Ads campaign list

insights.name: title missing the converting term
insights.rule: a live product title does not start with a top-20 converting search term for that product type
insights.sentence: {n} titles do not lead with the term that actually converts.
insights.severity: medium, fixes over weeks not days

insights.name: PMax hiding control
insights.rule: URL expansion, auto assets or final URL expansion is still on for an active PMax campaign
insights.sentence: {campaign} still has {setting} on. Turn it off to see and control what runs.

insights.name: brand not excluded from cold
insights.rule: a non-brand or PMax campaign has no brand negative list or exclusion applied
insights.sentence: {campaign} has no brand exclusion. Brand searches may be inflating its ROAS.

insights.name: search term wasting spend
insights.rule: a search term has spent over 2x average CPA with 0 conversions in 30 days
insights.sentence: '{term}' spent {amount} with 0 conversions. Add it as a negative.

insights.name: remarketing list too small
insights.rule: a remarketing or cart-abandoner list is below the platform's minimum serving size
insights.sentence: {list} has {n} members, below the size Google needs to serve it. Wait before launching.

insights.name: ready to progress bid strategy
insights.rule: conversion volume has held above the platform's Target ROAS threshold for 4 straight weeks on Maximize Conversion Value
insights.sentence: Volume has supported Target ROAS for 4 weeks. Consider moving up a stage.
insights.severity: low, an opportunity not a risk

insights.name: budget outside the sizing formula
insights.rule: daily budget falls outside the AOV or CPA-based sizing range for the campaign's stage
insights.sentence: {campaign}'s budget is {pct}% outside the recommended range for its stage.

insights.name: scaling gate failed
insights.rule: fewer than 5 of 5 scaling gates pass
insights.sentence: Only {n} of 5 scaling gates pass. Hold budget until the rest clear.

insights.name: Merchant Center disapproval spike
insights.rule: open disapprovals rose 25% or more week over week
insights.sentence: Disapprovals rose to {n} this week, up from {prev}.

insights.name: YouTube added too early
insights.rule: a YouTube or Demand Gen campaign is live while youtube_demand_gen_readiness has an unmet checklist item
insights.sentence: YouTube is spending before {unmet_item} is in place.

insights.name: conversion value gap
insights.rule: conversion_tracking_coverage is under 95%
insights.sentence: {pct}% of purchases are passing real order value. The rest look like $0 conversions to Google.

insights.name: Google vs blended MER gap
insights.rule: google_blended_mer_gap is 20% or more
insights.sentence: Google reports {google_roas}x but the brand's own numbers say {mer}x.

insights.name: non-brand above break-even
insights.rule: nonbrand_cpa_vs_breakeven is over 1.0
insights.sentence: Non-brand CPA is {pct}% over break-even. Cut before adding budget.

insights.name: campaign with no purpose on file
insights.rule: a live campaign has no one-line purpose note
insights.sentence: {campaign} has no written purpose. Reporting confusion usually starts here.

founder_view_note: Before Google Ads is connected, the room shows nothing but a clear 'not connected' state on every metric, since the direct Marketing API is not active yet (only Meta is read-only connected today). The first thing to show once it connects is conversion_tracking_coverage and the scaling gate checklist, since a tracking gap or a failed gate protects against the worst decision (scaling on fake data or before the account has earned it).

metrics.name: affiliate_pipeline
metrics.plain: How many applicants are waiting, approved or rejected
metrics.formula: count of applications by status (pending, approved, rejected)

metrics.name: active_partner_count
metrics.plain: How many affiliates and creators are actively earning
metrics.formula: count of partners with at least 1 sale in trailing 30 days

metrics.name: commission_owed_vs_paid
metrics.plain: Gap between what the network says is owed and what was actually paid
metrics.formula: network-reported commission owed minus verified paid amount
metrics.source: affiliate network payout report + brand payment record

metrics.name: fraud_flag_count
metrics.plain: Number of open suspected-fraud flags
metrics.formula: count of affiliates matching fast click-to-conversion, suspect ISP, brand-bidding or big-ticket-early-order patterns

metrics.name: commission_rate_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of partners with a set commission tier on file
metrics.formula: partners with an assigned tier / total active partners

metrics.name: marketplace_brief_status
metrics.plain: Where the Amazon, Walmart Connect or Target Roundel ads brief stands
metrics.formula: status flag: drafted, sent, acknowledged, live (manually updated)
metrics.source: brand record (Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Target Roundel consoles not connected)

metrics.name: marketplace_acos_reported
metrics.plain: Amazon's, Walmart's or Target's own ACOS, as last reported to us
metrics.formula: ad spend / ad-attributed sales, taken from whoever runs the account
metrics.source: manually entered from the marketplace's ads console (not connected)
metrics.unavailable_when: no connector to the marketplace ads console exists

metrics.name: flipkart_brief_status
metrics.plain: Where the Flipkart ads brief stands. India only; reads null for US brands, which use marketplace_brief_status instead.
metrics.formula: status flag: drafted, sent, acknowledged, live
metrics.unavailable_when: no brief created yet, or brand is not in India

metrics.name: rapid_delivery_plan_status
metrics.plain: Where the Instacart/DoorDash/Gopuff retail media plan stands, per platform
metrics.formula: status flag per platform: drafted, sent, live

metrics.name: quick_commerce_plan_status
metrics.plain: Where the Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart plan stands, per platform. India only; reads null for US brands, which use rapid_delivery_plan_status instead.
metrics.formula: status flag per platform: drafted, sent, live
metrics.unavailable_when: no plan created yet, or brand is not in India

metrics.name: rapid_delivery_roas_benchmark_gap
metrics.plain: How reported rapid-delivery/grocery marketplace ROAS compares to the category benchmark
metrics.formula: reported ROAS (manually entered) minus benchmark (4-8x established SKUs, 1.5-3x new launches)

metrics.name: quick_commerce_roas_benchmark_gap
metrics.plain: How reported quick-commerce ROAS compares to the category benchmark. India only; reads null for US brands, which use rapid_delivery_roas_benchmark_gap instead.
metrics.formula: reported ROAS (manually entered) minus benchmark (4-8x established SKUs, 1.5-3x new launches)
metrics.freshness_rule: unavailable until manually updated, or brand is not in India

metrics.name: retargeting_saturation_signal
metrics.plain: Whether Meta and Google retargeting pools are maxed out
metrics.formula: retargeting frequency at or above cap with flat reach, on both Meta and Google, for 14+ days
metrics.benchmark: used only to trigger a DSP evaluation (MEDIA-C54)

metrics.name: invoice_vs_reported_variance
metrics.plain: Gap between a platform's invoice and its own reported spend
metrics.formula: invoiced amount minus platform-reported spend for the same period
metrics.source: platform invoices (Meta, Google, TikTok) + platform reporting
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new invoice lands unmatched

metrics.name: invoice_vs_ledger_variance
metrics.plain: Gap between an invoice and the brand's own budget ledger
metrics.formula: invoiced amount minus ledger-recorded spend for the same period
metrics.unavailable_when: ledger entry missing for the period

metrics.name: sales_tax_1099_reconciliation_status
metrics.plain: Whether US sales tax charged on ad invoices and 1099 filings tied to the ledger are reconciled
metrics.formula: count of invoices with sales-tax and 1099 records matched to the accounting ledger / total invoices

metrics.name: gst_rcm_reconciliation_status
metrics.plain: Whether GST and reverse-charge credits on ad invoices are reconciled. India only; reads null for US brands, which use sales_tax_1099_reconciliation_status instead.
metrics.formula: count of invoices with GST/RCM matched to the credit ledger / total invoices
metrics.unavailable_when: accounting record not connected, or brand is not in India

metrics.name: billing_dispute_count
metrics.plain: Open disputes with a platform over billing
metrics.formula: count of open disputes

metrics.name: organic_mentions_found
metrics.plain: Creators found organically using or reviewing the product
metrics.formula: count of public posts matching the brand or close competitor, found this scan
metrics.source: public social scan (brand's own or a close competitor's product)

metrics.name: whitelist_outreach_conversion
metrics.plain: Share of discovered creators who became paid partners
metrics.formula: creators who signed on / creators contacted
metrics.benchmark: n/a, track for its own trend

metrics.name: affiliate_share_of_new_customers
metrics.plain: Share of new customers coming through the affiliate program
metrics.formula: new customers with an affiliate attribution / total new customers
metrics.unavailable_when: affiliate attribution not tagged on orders
metrics.benchmark: n/a, track for its own trend

metrics.name: coupon_abuse_rate
metrics.plain: Share of coupon redemptions that look abusive
metrics.formula: redemptions flagged (reused past limit, resold, or from a flagged affiliate) / total redemptions

insights.name: fast click-to-conversion fraud pattern
insights.rule: a new affiliate's clicks convert in under the platform's normal minimum browse time, repeatedly
insights.sentence: {affiliate} converts clicks in under {seconds}s, {n} times this week. Check for cookie stuffing.

insights.name: big-ticket order right after signup
insights.rule: a new affiliate generates an order for a top-price-band item within 48 hours of joining
insights.sentence: {affiliate} placed a {amount} order {hours}h after joining. Hold this payout for review.

insights.name: unusual orders-to-clicks ratio
insights.rule: an affiliate's orders-to-clicks ratio is 3x or more the program average
insights.sentence: {affiliate}'s conversion rate is {x} the program average.

insights.name: commission mismatch
insights.rule: commission_owed_vs_paid variance exceeds 2% of the payout cycle total
insights.sentence: The network wants {amount} more than verified sales support. Reconcile before paying.

insights.name: brand-bidding affiliate
insights.rule: an affiliate is found bidding on the brand's own name in paid search
insights.sentence: {affiliate} is bidding on '{brand_term}' in search. This usually breaks program terms.

insights.name: invoice does not match platform report
insights.rule: invoice_vs_reported_variance exceeds 1%
insights.sentence: {platform}'s invoice is {pct}% off its own reported spend for {period}.

insights.name: invoice does not match ledger
insights.rule: invoice_vs_ledger_variance is non-zero
insights.sentence: {platform}'s invoice is {amount} off the budget ledger for {period}.

insights.name: sales tax or 1099 credit unreconciled
insights.rule: an invoice's sales-tax charge or 1099 record has not been matched to the accounting ledger
insights.sentence: {n} invoices have sales-tax or 1099 records not yet matched.

insights.name: GST credit unreconciled
insights.rule: an invoice's GST/RCM has not been matched to the accounting credit ledger. India only; does not fire for US brands.
insights.sentence: {n} invoices have GST credits not yet matched.

insights.name: retargeting pool saturated
insights.rule: retargeting_saturation_signal is true on both Meta and Google
insights.sentence: Both Meta and Google retargeting are capped with flat reach. Worth a DSP pilot.
insights.severity: medium, an opportunity not a risk

insights.name: rapid-delivery retail media underperforming benchmark
insights.rule: rapid_delivery_roas_benchmark_gap is negative by more than 20%
insights.sentence: {platform} ROAS is {pct}% below the category benchmark.

insights.name: quick commerce underperforming benchmark
insights.rule: quick_commerce_roas_benchmark_gap is negative by more than 20%. India only; does not fire for US brands.
insights.sentence: {platform} ROAS is {pct}% below the category benchmark.

insights.name: organic mention worth whitelisting
insights.rule: a discovered organic mention has engagement above the brand's set threshold and is not already a paid partner
insights.sentence: {creator} is already showing your product organically with {engagement} engagement. Reach out before offering payment.

insights.name: coupon abuse rising
insights.rule: coupon_abuse_rate rose 1 point or more week over week
insights.sentence: Coupon abuse rose to {pct}% this week.

visuals.name: affiliate funnel
visuals.shows: applied, approved, active, flagged counts
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees where the program is leaking or growing in one shape

visuals.name: commission reconciliation table
visuals.shows: owed vs paid vs variance, per payout cycle, per affiliate above a threshold
visuals.why_this_chart: makes a payout dispute visible before money moves

visuals.name: billing reconciliation waterfall
visuals.shows: platform-reported spend, invoiced amount and ledger amount for the period, with the gaps labelled
visuals.why_this_chart: three numbers that should match rarely do; the waterfall shows exactly where they diverge

visuals.name: marketplace brief status board
visuals.shows: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, DoorDash and Gopuff briefs by status (drafted, sent, live), plus Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart briefs for the India option
visuals.why_this_chart: founder tracks handoff work with no live connector, without losing track of what was sent where

visuals.name: creator mention feed
visuals.shows: discovered organic mentions with engagement and whitelist status
visuals.why_this_chart: a feed matches how discovery naturally arrives, newest first

visuals.name: DSP readiness gauge
visuals.shows: days of sustained retargeting saturation against the threshold that triggers a DSP evaluation
visuals.why_this_chart: prevents a DSP pilot before saturation is proven, not just assumed

not_elsewhere.claim: flags affiliate fraud using fast click-to-conversion, suspect ISP, big-ticket-early-order and brand-bidding rules together, tied back to the exact commission owed
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Refersion for the vetting checks themselves, but Refersion flags fraud inside its own tracker and does not tie the flag to the brand's separate commission ledger

not_elsewhere.claim: reconciles what an affiliate network says is owed against verified sales and refunds before a payout is approved
not_elsewhere.vs: Refersion auto-verifies and auto-approves commissions from its own tracker; this room checks that number against the brand's order data first

not_elsewhere.claim: turns Amazon, Walmart, Target and rapid-delivery plans (Flipkart and quick-commerce plans for the India option) into a handoff brief with targeting, budget and a category ROAS benchmark, and says plainly that live performance stays unavailable until those accounts are connected
not_elsewhere.vs: no dashboard here claims to read Amazon, Walmart, Target, Flipkart or rapid-delivery/quick-commerce ad performance; the room is honest about the gap instead of guessing

not_elsewhere.claim: matches each platform's invoice, including applicable US sales tax and 1099 records (GST and reverse-charge credits for the India option), against both its own reported spend and the brand's budget ledger in one reconciliation
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta, Google and TikTok billing centers show an invoice against their own reported spend only, not the brand's ledger or its sales-tax and 1099 records

not_elsewhere.claim: surfaces creators already wearing or reviewing the product organically as whitelist candidates before any outreach cost is paid
not_elsewhere.vs: affiliate and influencer platforms track creators already inside the program, not organic mentions found outside it

not_elsewhere.claim: keeps founder-gate calls (fraud holds, payout disputes, DSP spend, commission tier changes) in one queue instead of split across the affiliate network's UI, each platform's billing page, and email
not_elsewhere.vs: no single tool spans affiliate, marketplace ad and platform billing decisions in one founder queue

data_needs.connector_or_script: affiliate network API or brand record
affiliate network payout report + brand order data
brand record (no connector to Amazon/Walmart/Target/Instacart yet; Flipkart/quick-commerce for the India option)

founder_view_note: Before any connector is live, the room shows the marketplace brief status board (Amazon, Walmart, Target, rapid-delivery marketplaces; Flipkart and quick commerce for the India option) as the one part that works today, since those briefs are handoff documents, not live reads, and marks every performance metric for those channels as unavailable with 'no connector yet' rather than a blank or a zero. Once the affiliate network and billing pulls connect, the first things to show are open fraud flags and invoice variance, since those two protect real money before anything else in this room does.
